reference.description: Exact directed O(N^2) neighbor set preserving target and source order

long_range_baseline.description: Existing Octree structural baseline for long-range gravity

policies.bounding_volume: axis-aligned bounding boxes over float64 particle coordinates
policies.split: longest AABB spatial extent; median; coordinate then particle index
policies.traversal: iterative LIFO; push right before left; stable particle index output
policies.rebuild: static build once; moving initial build plus refit; full rebuild baseline
policies.refit: bottom-up reverse node order with unchanged topology

decision.reason: BVH is qualified for irregular local queries only; no production long-range promotion is justified by this bounded evidence
promotion_requires: physical collision or SPH workload gain
memory and rebuild policy under target scale
downstream numerical parity and end-to-end evidence

invariants: AABBs are deterministic for a fixed frame and stable median split
traversal is iterative and emits sorted source indices per target
refit preserves topology and matches the full rebuild query result
both BVH and cell-linked results match the exact directed neighbor reference
Octree remains a separate long-range baseline and is not a local-neighbor oracle
the cell-linked candidate remains the selected local-neighbor policy
the BVH is not promoted into the production gravity path
